messages.subject: regionCounts() vs. selectByOverlap()
parts:
Hello!


I have a question regarding two methylKit functions. I am very new to R so I apologize in advance if my question is too simple or illogical.


I have RRBS data. My end goal is to have a list of differentially methylated cytosines, that are located in promoter regions. My question is would both functions, regionCounts()  and selectByOverlap() achieve the same result? My though process goes like this:


regionCounts() to summarize methylation information of methylRaw object over defined promoters

unite() to transform into a methylBase object

calculateDiffMeth()

getMethylDiff()

 

OR

 

selectByOverlap() to summarize methylation information of methylRawDB object over defined promoters

unite() to transform into a methylBase object

calculateDiffMeth()

getMethylDiff()


Thank you in advance for your input.


Best, Katarina

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] regionCounts() vs. selectByOverlap()
parts:
if you want differentially methylated cytosines on promoters go with the second option. Then you will get base-pairs that are differentially methylated 

Best,
Altuna
